headline: World Bank: SMEs in developing countries deprived of 4,000 billion dollars in financing
summary: Micro, small and medium enterprises in emerging and developing economies face an estimated $4 trillion financing shortfall, according to two World Bank reports published on November 17, 2026. These firms account for 90% of businesses and 75% of jobs.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that funds development projects and publishes research on credit access. SME finance gaps affect growth, employment and demand for banks and lenders in emerging markets.
original_headline: Banque mondiale : les PME des pays en développement privées de 4 000 milliards de dollars de financement
